verdict.rationale: Kong's own auth plugins (JWT, basic auth, OAuth) combined with ACLs let operators issue credentials to API consumers and restrict which routes they can reach. Dev Portal lets developers manage their own credentials, and Konnect claims entitlements definable down to agents, MCP servers and MCP tools. None of this explicitly documents issuing least-privilege credentials to an agent, so depth for the agent case is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit docs on scoped per-agent credentials (per-tool/operation scopes, expiry/rotation), scoped Konnect/Admin API tokens for agents, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
